prompts.name: room-static
prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: supplied cozy sunroom background. Create a clean STATIC BACKPLATE for a layered Unity game scene. Keep the exact landscape 16:9 composition, camera, dimensions, warm watercolor paper texture, low saturation macaron colors, window frame, sky, wooden floor, furniture, books, basket, floor flowers and all other objects in exactly the same places.
Remove ONLY these four foreground objects so they can be replaced with separately animated layers: (1) BOTH flowing cream curtains along the upper-left/window area, leaving the open window and wall behind cleanly reconstructed; (2) the small eucalyptus pot ON THE WINDOW SILL, including its pot and foliage; (3) the trailing eucalyptus potted plant at the LEFT END OF THE UPPER-RIGHT SHELF, including its little pot, upright leaves and dangling vine. Keep the far-right tall plant and all lower corner plants unchanged. Reconstruct the appropriate wall/window/shelf behind these four objects without holes or residual ghost edges. All central floor and other artwork must stay unchanged. Do not add new decorations. No text, animals, UI or watermark. Full opaque background, same 16:9 image.

prompts.name: ambience-atlas
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent SPRITE ATLAS for the referenced cozy sunroom game. Exact 1536x1024, 3 columns x 2 rows, each cell 512x512. Six separate sprites centered inside their cell with at least 24px transparent margin. TRUE transparent background, no baked paper backdrop, no labels, no shadow outside objects. Match the reference's warm brown hand drawn pencil outline, creamy watercolor paper fill, muted macaron sage/peach.
TOP LEFT: one LEFT-side cream linen curtain, top edge horizontal and attached, draping outward toward the left at the bottom, soft flowing folds, near rectangular/tapered silhouette filling height 460px and width300px. Top is FIXED and cloth hangs downward. ONLY fabric, no window or rod.
TOP MIDDLE: one RIGHT-side cream linen curtain, top horizontal edge attached, draping outward to the right at the bottom, soft flowing folds, about height460px width330px. ONLY fabric, no window or rod.
TOP RIGHT: the little sage eucalyptus in a round pale terracotta pot, like the window sill plant from the reference, rounded leaves with cocoa outlines, entire pot included, upright plant height420px width330px.
BOTTOM LEFT: small cream terracotta potted trailing eucalyptus like the left end of shelf plant in reference, upright round sage leaves above pot and delicate curved leafy stem cascading down toward lower left. Whole sprite height440px width330px.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: ONE large simple pale dusty pink sakura blossom PETAL, not an entire flower, curved heart/teardrop with a notch, one subtle darker pink vein, isolated centered and filling 180px, no leaf or flower cluster. Needed for drifting cherry blossom particles.
BOTTOM RIGHT: ONE soft sage/ochre leaf, rounded lanceolate shape, simple cocoa stem and one light vein, slightly curled, isolated centered filling200px. Needed for occasional wind-blown leaves.
Flat 2D hand-painted sprites, warm quiet low-saturation colors, clean alpha edges. Do not add animals, letters, furniture, frames or duplicate sprites. All six fully within equal grid cells.
